programme_facts.value: The customizable curriculum broadens your knowledge of a range of topics from traditional literary and rhetorical analysis and curriculum design to research and multimodal compositions. In addition to building core competencies in linguistics, literature, writing and English education, you’ll also choose electives that support your interests. To culminate the program, you’ll engage in a capstone experience in which you’ll synthesize and create a public-facing display of your work.
